name: Chic Republic Public Company Limited
summary: Chic Republic Public Company Limited, along with its subsidiaries, operates a network of retail stores across Thailand dedicated to home fashion. These establishments, trading under the Chic Republic and Rina Hey banners, offer an extensive range of items. Customers can find furniture, various household goods, kitchenware, ornamental lighting, and a selection of mattresses and bedding. The company was established in 2017 and maintains its principal office in Bangkok, Thailand.
